title: Home practical guide and safety card: spoon conduction test
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Metals and their uses (8G); energy transfers (8K)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 53 (Home practical guide and safety card: spoon conduction test (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 53: Conduction and convection. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To compare how well different spoons conduct thermal energy
safety: An adult handles the hot water
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Stick a pea with butter at the same height on each spoon
Stand the spoons in the mug on a tray
An adult pours in hot water
Rank the spoons from best to worst conductor

head: Spoon
Time for the pea to fall (s)

questions.q: Energy carried by a moving warm fluid is...
Big question: why does the metal spoon handle get hot?
questions.a: Metal conducts: particles and free electrons pass energy along it.
